title: The WoW: A Large-Scale World Knowledge Corpus for Full-Lifecycle LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.13487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing Chinese educational corpora often suffer from fragmented coverage and a lack of systematic organization. In this paper, we propose WoW (\textbf{Wo}rld Kno\textbf{w}ledge), a large-scale dataset designed for the full-cycle training of foundation models. The construction of this dataset is driven by an Educational Knowledge Graph, which serves as a taxonomic backbone for the systematic collection and completion of missing educational modules across all levels. Compared to previous versions, this iteration provides enhanced systematicity, superior quality, and a larger scale, while incorporating multimodal signals and supporting every stage of model development. Experiments demonstrate that WoW significantly improves model performance across diverse benchmarks. To facilitate community research, we further provide an interactive platform for graph-based data selection and retrieval.

translated_title: WoW：一个用于大语言模型全生命周期训练的大规模世界知识语料库
translated_abstract: 现有的中文教育语料库通常存在覆盖碎片化、缺乏系统性组织的问题。本文提出了WoW（World Knowledge，世界知识），一个专为基座模型全周期训练设计的大规模数据集。该数据集的构建由教育知识图谱驱动，该图谱作为分类主干，用于系统性收集和补全涵盖各个教育阶段的缺失教育模块。与之前的版本相比，本次迭代具备更强的系统性、更高的质量和更大的规模，同时融入了多模态信号，并支持模型开发的各个阶段。实验表明，WoW在多个基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。为促进社区研究，我们还提供了一个基于图谱的数据选择与检索交互平台。
tldr: 本文提出WoW——一个由教育知识图谱驱动、支持大语言模型全生命周期训练的大规模世界知识语料库，在多个基准上显著提升模型性能，并提供交互式图谱数据选择与检索平台。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WoW, a large-scale world knowledge corpus driven by an educational knowledge graph for full-lifecycle LLM training, which significantly improves model performance across benchmarks and provides an interactive graph-based data selection and retrieval platform.
